title: Blog Index Template
howToUse: Link the shipped foundation ONCE (do not copy it): <link rel=stylesheet href="{% static 'keel_cms/css/blog-index.css' %}">, put data-keel-catalog="blog-index" on the blog-index root element, and {% include 'keel_cms/blog_index/_icons.html' %} inside <body>. Pinning a newer keel-cms version then delivers every foundation fix (theming, RTL, motion, a11y) automatically.
Decide which blocks the project blog index needs (usually one hero + one latest, plus any of trending/category/media/slider/live/learn).
For each chosen block pick exactly ONE variant using bestFor / layout below.
Copy only that variant's <article data-keel-variant> subtree into the project template (the styling is already linked, not copied).
Include the bundled behavior only if any chosen variant has requiresJs=true (all slider and live variants): <script src="{% static 'keel_cms/js/blog-index.js' %}" defer></script>.

Theme by overriding the foundation tokens on the root (or set --brand once — --accent inherits it). Category colour comes from --cat: tag each chip/avatar with an .accent-N helper (or a host class that assigns --cat) — no topic names are baked in. Keep 16:9 media and never put text over an image.

sharedFoundation.consumption: Linked, not copied. blog-index.css is scoped under [data-keel-catalog="blog-index"], so it never collides with the host's own .card/.title/.meta. Hosts copy only per-variant markup; foundation fixes propagate by version pin.

assets.css: keel_cms/css/blog-index.css (tokens + every component/block layout; light + dark; RTL-ready via logical properties; a prefers-reduced-motion blanket).
assets.js: keel_cms/js/blog-index.js (slider + live behavior; load only for requiresJs variants).
assets.iconsPartial: keel_cms/blog_index/_icons.html ({% include %} once; the #i-* SVG sprite).

sharedFoundation.designTokens: CSS custom properties on the [data-keel-catalog] root — surface/text/border/accent, an 8-slot category palette (--cat-1..8, neutral — NOT topic names), spacing scale, radius, shadow, --container, --scrim, fonts. Override per project; --accent inherits --brand.
sharedFoundation.theming: Dark theme is automatic by prefers-color-scheme and forceable with data-theme="dark" (opt out per subtree with data-theme="light"). Chip/badge tints mix against --surface, so they re-theme in both modes.
sharedFoundation.categoryColors: One .chip rule + .accent-1..8 helpers set --cat. Map the slots to the project's own verticals; the demo's topic names live only in content, never in the CSS.
rules: Every image is 16:9 (aspect-ratio:16/9; object-fit:cover) and carries width/height (CLS); the hero lead models srcset/sizes + fetchpriority.
No text over images — play/live indicators are icon controls; textual badges sit outside the image.
Tokens only (no stray hex); logical properties (RTL-ready).
Semantic tags + named selectors; prefers-reduced-motion honored.

blocks.title: Hero / Featured News
blocks.purpose: Above-the-fold lead: one prominent story plus a set of supporting items.
blocks.whenToUse: The top of the blog index. Pick exactly one hero variant.

variants.name: Classic Split
variants.layout: 60/40 split — a large lead feature on the left, six stacked list items on the right.
variants.bestFor: A single dominant lead beside a scannable secondary list.

variants.name: Top Hero Grid
variants.layout: A full-width horizontal lead above a four-column strip of supporting cards.
variants.bestFor: One lead plus an even row of equally-weighted follow-ups.

variants.name: Center Hero Asymmetric
variants.layout: A central feature flanked by two cards on the left and two on the right.
variants.bestFor: A balanced, magazine-style front with a strong centerpiece.

variants.name: Magazine Mosaic
variants.layout: A 2-row lead tile with five smaller cards staggered around it.
variants.bestFor: A dense editorial mosaic when several strong stories compete.

variants.name: Lead + Quad & Sidebar
variants.layout: A lead over a 2x2 sub-grid, plus one tall highlight card on the right edge.
variants.bestFor: A lead, a compact cluster, and one evergreen highlight together.

blocks.title: Latest News Grid
blocks.whenToUse: The core list of recent posts on the index.

variants.name: 3-Column Standard Cards
variants.layout: A uniform three-column grid of vertical cards (image, tag, title, excerpt, byline footer).
variants.bestFor: The default, predictable chronological feed.

variants.name: Horizontal Card Rows
variants.layout: A two-column layout of image-left / text-right cards.
variants.bestFor: A scannable feed that shows more text per card.

variants.name: Masonry / Varied Cards
variants.layout: A multi-column masonry grid; card heights vary by excerpt length.
variants.bestFor: A lively, non-uniform feed that breaks grid monotony.

variants.name: Density-Focused Grid
variants.layout: A compact four-column grid with small thumbnails and dense metadata.
variants.bestFor: High-volume output where many items must fit above the fold.

variants.name: Bento Box News Grid
variants.layout: A 2x2 lead tile beside a block of four small cards, then a uniform row.
variants.bestFor: A feed with built-in hierarchy — one hero item per band.

blocks.title: Trending / Most Read
blocks.purpose: Typography-driven ranking of most-read or momentum stories.

variants.name: Numbered Rank List
variants.layout: A vertical list with large 01-05 rank numerals, tiny thumbnails and view/comment stats.
variants.bestFor: A most-read module or sidebar.

variants.name: Accordion / Expanding List
variants.layout: A native <details> list; the open item reveals a full image, excerpt and byline.
variants.bestFor: A compact list that expands on demand — no JavaScript.

variants.name: Tabbed Trending
variants.layout: CSS-only tabs (Hourly / Daily / Weekly) over a two-column ranked list with thumbnails.
variants.bestFor: Switching trending windows without navigation — no JavaScript.

variants.name: Timeline Trending
variants.layout: A chronological rail with connectors, timestamps and 16:9 thumbnails.
variants.bestFor: A time-ordered 'what happened' rundown.

variants.name: Horizontal Scrolling Cards
variants.layout: A snap-scrolling strip of compact ranked cards with momentum stats.
variants.bestFor: A swipeable trending row, mobile-first.

blocks.title: Category Spotlight
blocks.purpose: Topic/section spotlight: an anchor story per topic plus related headlines.
blocks.whenToUse: Surfacing a specific section (Tech, Business, Politics, ...).

variants.name: 1 Big + 4 Item List Split
variants.layout: One large lead article beside a four-item thumbnail headline list.
variants.bestFor: Spotlighting a section with one anchor plus quick links.

variants.name: Multi-Category Columns
variants.layout: Three parallel topic columns, each a full lead card over three thumbnail headlines.
variants.bestFor: Showing several sections side by side.

variants.name: Feature Story + Sub-topic Grid
variants.layout: A wide horizontal feature over a three-column sub-topic grid.
variants.bestFor: A section front: one feature plus its sub-topics.

variants.name: Editorial Highlight Block
variants.layout: A tinted container: one major analysis piece beside five single-column briefing cards.
variants.bestFor: An opinion/analysis highlight with related briefs.

variants.name: Side-by-Side Dual Feature
variants.layout: Two equal-weight stories side by side, each with two nested sub-headlines.
variants.bestFor: Pitting two co-lead stories with their follow-ups.

blocks.title: Media / Video / Multimedia
blocks.whenToUse: When the blog has watch or listen content.

variants.name: Main Video Player Layout
variants.layout: One large 16:9 player (icon play control) beside a four-item playlist.
variants.bestFor: A featured video with an up-next queue.

variants.name: Video Carousel / Strip
variants.layout: A four-column row of video cards with duration chips and view counts.
variants.bestFor: A row of related clips.

variants.name: Dark Mode Media Strip
variants.layout: A dark-themed container holding a five-item video grid with channel tags.
variants.bestFor: A visually distinct video shelf that contrasts the page.

variants.name: Video + Audio / Podcast Hybrid
variants.layout: A split: three video cards on one side, three podcast cards (with waveforms) on the other.
variants.bestFor: Mixing watch and listen in one module.

variants.name: Grid Showcase with Live Stream
variants.layout: One LIVE card (status badge + viewer count) plus four categorized replay cards.
variants.bestFor: A live stream with recent replays.

blocks.title: Sliders / Carousels
blocks.purpose: Interactive, swipeable modules (require the bundled script).
blocks.whenToUse: When paging or rotation lets you fit more stories in less space.

variants.name: Card Carousel
variants.layout: Four vertical cards in a row; header prev/next slide the next set into view.
variants.bestFor: An 'in depth' shelf the reader pages through.

variants.name: Featured Rotator + Side List
variants.layout: A big featured story auto-rotates (dots + arrows) beside a fixed side list.
variants.bestFor: A rotating hero with an accompanying headline list.

variants.name: Full-Width Story Slider
variants.layout: One wide split slide (image + text) rotates through the day's lead stories.
variants.bestFor: A cinematic single-story rotator.

variants.name: Thumbnail-Nav Gallery
variants.layout: One large slide switched by a strip of thumbnail buttons below.
variants.bestFor: A curated set the reader browses by thumbnail.

blocks.title: Live / Real-Time
blocks.purpose: Real-time, continuously-updating modules (require the bundled script).
blocks.whenToUse: For live events, breaking coverage, or a 'happening now' feel.

variants.name: Auto-Updating Feed Column
variants.layout: Every few seconds a new item flashes in at the top and the oldest fades out.
variants.bestFor: A wire / breaking feed that must feel live.

variants.name: Breaking Ticker + Latest
variants.layout: A continuously scrolling breaking-news marquee over a self-refreshing list.
variants.bestFor: A breaking-news bar plus a latest list.

variants.name: Live Blog (Minute-by-Minute)
variants.layout: A timestamped live blog with a visible countdown that posts a new update at zero.
variants.bestFor: Minute-by-minute event coverage.

variants.name: Live Now Dashboard
variants.layout: 'Happening now' live streams with ticking viewer counters and a moving market strip.
variants.bestFor: A live status board or 'now' page.

blocks.title: Explainer / Learn
blocks.whenToUse: When the goal is to teach — explainers, how-it-works, glossary, a series.

variants.name: Explainer Cards
variants.layout: 'Understand it in a minute' cards: learn badge, difficulty level, key-takeaway checklist, learn-time.
variants.bestFor: Explaining the concept behind a story.

variants.name: Step-by-Step How It Works
variants.layout: A numbered four-step path, each step with an image and a short instruction.
variants.bestFor: Walking through a process or mechanism.

variants.name: Glossary / Key Terms
variants.layout: A jargon-buster grid; click a term to expand its definition (CSS-only <details>).
variants.bestFor: Defining key terms inline — no JavaScript.

variants.name: Learning Series / Curriculum
variants.layout: A featured course beside a numbered syllabus with a progress bar and per-lesson times.
variants.bestFor: A multi-part educational series or academy module.
